notes.title: Big Update: Arcade Mode & Achievements added, and Simfest: Hobby Edition!
notes.content:
Hey all you radical people!  We have an awesome update for you today- Arcade Mode!  Several players have requested an arcade-only mode, where you don't have to worry about any of the puzzles- you can just hang out and play games in the arcade.  And it's here now in our latest update!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301113/8bbbe0cd988c21530a45dcb2c601fd18093c5090.png
Load up the "Arcade Mode" DVD to just jump right to the arcade- no mysteries to worry about, just your skeeball technique and basketball form.
We plan on adding more machines and fun stuff to arcade mode.  We'd love to hear from you if you suggestions!  Check out http://arcade.lunabeat.com to submit suggestions on new arcade games to include!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301113/9efe9c0368fcfc9674b9cff8a3d0cffa964a8429.png

You can also send in suggestions/feedback via our Twitter and Discord.  We love hearing from our players!! If you want to see something in our game, we want to know about it so we can try to add it in :)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301113/683c33658e553ae869e32c648528af16df8ca236.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301113/f6727308f9554aa94249e930874377fffd48925f.jpg

We also added Achievements!  There are 14 achievements you can score- can you nab 'em all??  Can you beat the high score for basketball, find all sorts of hidden treasures, and figure out how to cheat against the evil robot??  Find out now- grab those achievements for all to see and admire!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301113/e39fc240c6ac54ebdbf7da39c4629fdea83d19a0.gif

Finally, Paranormal Detective: Escape from the 90's was invited to be included in the Simfest: Hobby Edition Steam event happening this week!!  We're super thrilled to have been included in this exclusive event, and we're doing 2 livestreams to celebrate- one on Monday with Laura, one on Tuesday with Scott.  Here are the details!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301113/801bbd5c88db5cbdd75309f633f58b080c48f8c0.jpg

That's all for this update- thanks so much for checking out the game & we hope you enjoy the new Arcade Mode & Achievements!! Go get 'em!

notes.title: Update for 2/8/2022
notes.content:
Large update to fix bugs and improve the quality of the experience:

- Air Hockey AI Improved.
- You can now teleport while holding most objects. 
- Fixed the snap location for the phone on Oculus controllers. 
- Added colliders under several tables to prevent items from falling through. 
- Updated controller bindings and made teleport/snap turning less sensitive.
- Updated bindings for Cosmos and WMR controllers.
- Changed notes around a certain puzzle to make it a bit more clear.
- Changed penguin figures to have a square base to prevent rolling.
- Added tone when entering a correct password in some instances.
- Added an out of order sign to an unused coin machine. 
- Fixed a spot where the pinball was getting stuck. 
- Fixed odd haptic feedback while teleporting. 
- Improved some solution elements.
- Moved tally marks in closet.
- Changed two table colors to make it easier to see objects on them.
- Removed teleport noises.
- Fixed a credit
- Fixed a bug that left a button highlights on gamedude
- Button hints now reappear on pinball every time you go to play
- Removed highlight from pinball buttons
- Adjusted some sound volumes
- Added haptic feedback to air hockey hits

Thanks again to all who have played and keep the feedback coming please!  

Will be working on smooth locomotion, smooth turning, pinball improvements and arcade only mode next. :)

notes.title: Post-Launch Update Schedule
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Just wanted to check in with a post-launch update- WOW!!  What a wild and crazy week!! We've been so thrilled to see Paranormal Detective: Escape from the 90's launch, and to see it go well!

We were on top of New and Trending VR, in the Big Adventure Event, got lots of amazing reviews, a week full of streamers, and tons of fun ideas from players to add in.

Thank you so much to everyone who has played the game, reviewed it, streamed it, talked about it, recommended it, gazed lovingly at it, or danced along to the little song at the end.  Thank you so very much!

We patched the game a couple times last week, but there are more updates coming this week.

There's some high-priority issues to tackle right away, mostly the air hockey table losing the puck, and [spoiler]not dropping prize items properly[/spoiler].  We've got a couple other bugs that need a reboot to fix, so we're addressing these first.

After that, we'll do more QOL fixes and updates through the week, and achievements will likely be added soon as well.  We'll also be working on alt movement methods like smooth locomotion and will get you an update on when to expect it soon.

We'll keep you updated here on Steam, Twitter and Discord.
You're invited to join our Discord btw!  Check out our daily dev updates and let us know if you have suggestions or find any bugs.  We love suggestions and hate bugs, so if you have either please join and tell us about them!

We also have Steam Discussion pages to post in, or you can always send us an email mail@lunabeat.com or tweet at us here: https://twitter.com/lunabeatgames

Thank you again for such an amazing launch, we couldn't have done it without all of you!
And keep your eyes out for more updates this week :)

-LunaBeat

notes.title: Original "Paranormal Detective" Game on Sale, New Patreon & Merch Shop!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301113/0877291b2e6fd965d87afbaa7a08f40b9ada4e57.png

Original Paranormal Detective Game on Sale!
So "Paranormal Detective: Escape from the 90's" is actually a sequel to a VR game we put out in 2019.  The original game is set in a kid's game room in the 80's, and it's called "Paranormal Detective: Escape from the 80's".  You have to go through all the kid's old stuff- retro toys, electronics, etc and solve a bunch of puzzles to find out what happened to the missing kid.  There's also a super cool Cyber World where you get to play retro arcade games!
It's a really fun escape room and if you like our 90's game, we think you'll like the 80's one too!
Finally, it's on sale this week!!  Check it out for 35% off- $6.49 USD!
